capacity_basis.mmap_caveat: Payload arithmetic only: direct-BF16 construction uses mmap assignment before native copy loading. Whether and when all pages become anonymous is not established by header arithmetic. No proof that native must OOM, and no GPU/OOM trial was run.
capacity_basis.native_result: Fit is not verified on this host; excluded under the explicit skip policy, not proof that every native execution must OOM.
